title: 授業参観と保護者会
subject_en: School parent-visit scenes in a flat style: classroom, desks, teacher, parents; each a small complete scene, people with simple faces Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
lead: 授業参観・保護者会・個人面談など、学校行事の場面12点の素材です。学校だよりや保護者向けの資料に使えます。
